dedupe_keys.name: c l s band optical network design exploiting amplifier site upgrade strategies

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. A network simulation evaluates where additional amplification sites should shorten fibre spans to improve wideband transmission. The model compares delivered capacity and required interfaces while limiting the number of new sites. Coverage is C+L+S network design, with physical-quality differences across bands explicitly motivating the optimisation. The description does not identify every candidate-site coordinate or cost assumption. This is a documented placement model, not an inventory of installed amplifiers. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
